tagline: Official tournament and rankings workflow for serious billiards — live data, AI coaching, and tools directors actually use.
elevator_pitch: One place for WPBA/WPA-style rankings, tournament history, head-to-head, player performance, and optional AI video coaching — with premium live ratings for subscribers who want rack-by-rack signal.
differentiators: Built around real tournament operations: brackets, scorekeeping, and data that stay in sync with how events are run.
Player-facing depth: performance, movement, and history in one app — not just a static list.
ALFa Rating and live estimated rating (PRO) are designed for this ecosystem, not generic handicaps.
AI Coach tiers scale from try-before-you-buy to heavy analysis and longer video uploads.
Director and score keeper modes exist for the table, not only for spectators.

vs_competitors.generic_handicap_apps: Many apps focus on a single handicap number. Here you get rankings context, event history, head-to-head, and optional coaching tied to your play.
vs_competitors.manual_spreadsheets: No more juggling exports — brackets, results, and player views live in one authenticated platform.
vs_competitors.social_only: This is competition infrastructure: roles, permissions, and data integrity matter.

pro_only_app_features: Live Est. Rating during active play (rack-by-rack updates).
ALFa Rating in rankings and premium live tournament views (replaces legacy Fargo-style emphasis over time for subscribers).
navigation_hints: Rankings: browse WPBA/WPA lists, filters, and movement.
Tournament History: past events, placements, and filters.
Head-to-Head: pick two players for side-by-side comparison.
Player Performance: deep stats and AI-written summaries for allowed players.
AI Coach: upload video for analysis (tier limits apply).
